note: The Batch C report carried an inconsistent count: '12 unmatched pathways, OH: 6, NY: 4'. Six and four are ten. This is the reconciliation, measured rather than restated.

whatTheArithmeticGotWrong.andTheDirectionWasInverted: The phrase 'unmatched pathways' reads as route contracts with no compiled pathway. There are none: 144 route contracts across src/lib/legal-authority/routes/ all resolve to a compiled pathway, and `node scripts/apply-legal-authority-to-profiles.mjs --check` reports that the compiled profiles match the approved contracts. The real gap runs the other way — compiled pathways carrying no legal-authority route contract — and in Ohio and New York there are exactly ten of them.
whatTheArithmeticGotWrong.howItWasMeasured: Every pathway in the compiled OH and NY profiles, minus every routeKey present in src/lib/legal-authority/routes/. Ohio has 7 compiled pathways and 1 contract; New York has 5 and 1.

classifications.CONTRACT_REQUIRED_COMMERCIAL_AND_RATIFIE: Counsel has ratified the route and the evaluator admits payment, and no route contract states its statute, timing, required facts or packet family. The highest-priority gap: a route that can take money and has no controlling legal statement of what it is.
classifications.CONTRACT_REQUIRED_COMMERCIAL_AND_HELD: The evaluator admits payment but counsel holds the route on a named gate. A contract is still required; nothing opens while the gate stands.
classifications.CONTRACT_AND_RATIFICATION_REQUIRED: The evaluator admits payment and counsel has not classified the route at all. Both a contract and a ratification decision are outstanding.
classifications.AUTOMATIC_RELIEF_CONTRACT_REQUIRED_FOR_G: An automatic route that files nothing and takes no payment. It still needs a contract, because what the participant is told about automatic relief is a legal statement and currently has no controlling source.

pathways.label: Adult non-conviction sealing or expungement under § 2953.33
pathways.exactDelta: A route contract naming Ohio Rev. Code § 2953.33, its timing anchor, its required facts and its packet family.

pathways.label: Conditional / treatment sealing under CPL 160.58
pathways.exactDelta: A route contract naming CPL § 160.58, the treatment-completion trigger, and its packet family.

pathways.label: Discretionary conviction sealing by petition under CPL 160.59
pathways.exactDelta: A route contract naming CPL § 160.59, its ten-year clock and anchor, the two-conviction cap and the excluded-offense list, and its packet family.

pathways.label: Adult conviction sealing or expungement under Ohio Rev. Code § 2953.32
pathways.exactDelta: A route contract naming § 2953.32 and the substantive eligibility gate counsel is holding it on, so the gate has a controlling statement to be implemented against.

pathways.label: Human-trafficking-survivor conviction expungement under § 2953.36
pathways.exactDelta: A route contract naming § 2953.36, and a ratification decision. The evaluator admits payment for a route counsel has not classified.

pathways.label: Human-trafficking-survivor non-conviction expungement under § 2953.521
pathways.exactDelta: A route contract naming § 2953.521, and a ratification decision. It must be kept separate from § 2953.36: one is a conviction remedy and one is not.

pathways.label: Certain firearm / carry conviction expungement under § 2953.35
pathways.exactDelta: A route contract naming § 2953.35 and its offense scope, and a ratification decision.

pathways.label: Juvenile sealing and expungement
pathways.exactDelta: A route contract naming the juvenile chapter and its separate sealing and expungement stages, and a ratification decision. A juvenile route sharing an adult route's contract would be the same category error the New York combined route is.

pathways.label: Automatic Clean Slate sealing under CPL 160.57
pathways.exactDelta: A route contract stating what Clean Slate seals, when it takes effect, what it excludes, and what a participant should and should not do while waiting. Payment is already closed; the gap is that the guidance has no controlling source.

pathways.label: Marijuana-record destruction under the MRTA
pathways.exactDelta: A route contract stating what the MRTA destroys as against what it seals, and how a participant verifies it happened. Destruction and sealing are different outcomes and must not be described interchangeably.
